# Mnemo Python SDK (mnemo-protocol)

> Python client for the Mnemo API. Mnemo gives embedding vectors a verifiable identity: embed a vector to get a watermarked copy and a `vector_uid`; verify any vector to learn whether it is one of yours. The SDK authenticates with an account API key and uses that account's subscription plan. It does not implement accountless agent namespaces or x402 payments.

API base: https://api.trymnemo.com

## Core operations

- `embed(vector, model_id, *, model_version="1.0", policy=None, subject=None)` → `POST /v1/embed`. Returns `vector_uid`, `watermarked_vector`, `created_at`, `dimensions`, and `subject_proof` (only when a `subject` was supplied and the server-side subject-proof transport is enabled and configured).
- `verify(vector, *, subject_proof=None)` → `POST /v1/verify`. Returns a `VerifyResult` (`verified`, `confidence`, `vector_uid`, `policy_ok`, optional `signals`) when a watermark is detected, otherwise `None`.
- `health()` → `GET /v1/health` (no auth required). Returns `status`, `version`, `timestamp`.
- `usage()` → `GET /v1/usage`. Returns `embed_count`, `verify_count`, `period` (`YYYY-MM`), `tier`, `embed_limit`, `verify_limit`.

Vectors must have 512–4096 finite numbers. There are **no batch endpoints** and no batch methods.

## Authentication

Header `X-API-Key: <your API key>` on every request (the SDK sets it from `MnemoClient(api_key=...)`). Accounts and API keys: sign in at https://www.trymnemo.com/login.

## Billing for API keys

- Calls with an API key use the account's subscription plan: included monthly verifications, no automatic overage, no top-ups, never x402. Plans and prices: https://www.trymnemo.com/pricing
- When the plan's verifications are used up, `POST /v1/verify` answers `402 {"code": "insufficient_credits"}` without a `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header. The SDK raises `MnemoAPIError(status_code=402, code=MnemoErrorCode.QUOTA_EXCEEDED, details={"code": "insufficient_credits"})`. Do not try to pay; there is no payment path for API keys.

## Quickstart (Python)

```python
from mnemo_sdk import MnemoClient
client = MnemoClient(api_key="your-api-key")          # default api_url: https://api.trymnemo.com
result = client.embed(vector=my_embedding, model_id="text-embedding-3-small")  # 512–4096 floats
check = client.verify(vector=retrieved_vector)
if check is None:
    print("No watermark detected.")
else:
    print(check.verified, check.confidence, check.vector_uid)
```

## Agents without an account

Autonomous agents without an account use the Mnemo Agent API directly over HTTP (this SDK does not wrap it): create a short-lived namespace, embed, read lineage, and pay 0.01 USDC per healthy verification via x402 on Base mainnet.

- Protocol: https://www.trymnemo.com/agent-protocol.md
- Agent orientation: https://www.trymnemo.com/llms.txt
- Public repository: https://github.com/MnemoProtocol/mnemo-agent-protocol

## Trusted subject binding (optional)

You may optionally bind a **subject** to an embed and replay a **server-issued proof** at verify time. The Mnemo service processes the subject and issues and checks any proof. The SDK is **transport only** — it never creates, validates, or interprets a proof.

SDK types: `Subject`, `SubjectProof`, `VerifySignals`.

```python
from mnemo_sdk import MnemoClient, Subject
client = MnemoClient(api_key="your-api-key")
emb = client.embed(my_embedding, model_id="text-embedding-3-small",
                   subject=Subject(subject_uri="mnemo://subj/tenant/document/doc-1",
                                   subject_type="document"))
# emb.subject_proof is an opaque, server-issued carrier (or None if the server
# transport is disabled). Store it; replay it verbatim on verify.
check = client.verify(emb.watermarked_vector, subject_proof=emb.subject_proof)
```

Contract:
- `subject` is **client context**; the Mnemo service processes it and the SDK only transports it. The client cannot supply service-set fields (`subject_fingerprint`, `trust_mode`, `proof*`).
- `subject_proof` is an **opaque proof token issued and checked by the service**. Store it and pass it back on verify unchanged; only the service can check it. Do not parse it. It may be absent if the feature is not enabled.
- The service decides when a proof is used; it does not imply extra work or latency on every verify.
- Missing/invalid proofs **fail closed** server-side.

## Policy

```python
from mnemo_sdk import PolicyBuilder
policy = PolicyBuilder().ttl_days(30).region("us").usage_class("std").build()
result = client.embed(vector=vec, model_id="...", policy=policy)
```

Policy fields (`ttl_hours`, `usage_class`, `retention`, `region`) are passed through to the server unchanged.

## Install

```bash
pip install mnemo-protocol
```

The PyPI package is `mnemo-protocol`, imported as `mnemo_sdk`. The unrelated PyPI projects `mnemo-sdk` and `mnemo-ai` are not Mnemo's.

Single dependency: `requests`. No local algorithm code. All watermarking is server-side.

## Not in v1

- MCP: planned; there is no public MCP server. Use the HTTP API.
- Batch embed/verify.
